title: Single-Pipe Steady-State Natural Gas Segment
description: Single 50 km natural gas transmission pipeline connecting a fixed-pressure supply hub to a city-gate delivery terminal under AGA8 equation of state.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<PipelineStudio id="single_pipe_gas" title="Single-Pipe Steady-State Natural Gas Segment" simulationType="TGNET">
  <Nodes>
    <Node name="Supply_Hub" type="SUPPLY" elevation="12m" pressure="72.0bar" flow="65.0" />
    <Node name="City_Gate" type="DELIVERY" elevation="18m" minDeliveryPressure="40.0bar" flow="65.0" />
  </Nodes>
  <Pipes>
    <Pipe name="Segment_101" from="Supply_Hub" to="City_Gate" length="50.0km" diameter="24inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="90.0bar" />
  </Pipes>
  <GasComposition ch4="0.93" c2h6="0.04" c3h8="0.012" co2="0.008" n2="0.010" h2="0.00" ghv="38.9" />
  <SimulationControls startTime="0" endTime="3600" timeStep="60" eos="AGA8" steadyStateFirst="true" />
</PipelineStudio>

title: Compressor Station Pressure Boost Loop
description: 190 km regional natural gas trunkline with a mid-route centrifugal compressor station maintaining 82 bar discharge pressure across two high-pressure pipe segments.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<PipelineStudio id="compressor_boost" title="Compressor Station Pressure Boost Loop" simulationType="TGNET">
  <Nodes>
    <Node name="Gas_Plant_Inlet" type="SUPPLY" elevation="15m" pressure="70.0bar" flow="115.0" />
    <Node name="CS1_Suction" type="JUNCTION" elevation="32m" />
    <Node name="CS1_Discharge" type="JUNCTION" elevation="32m" />
    <Node name="Metro_Terminal" type="DELIVERY" elevation="10m" minDeliveryPressure="38.0bar" flow="115.0" />
  </Nodes>
  <Pipes>
    <Pipe name="Trunk_Upstream" from="Gas_Plant_Inlet" to="CS1_Suction" length="85.0km" diameter="30inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="95.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Trunk_Downstream" from="CS1_Discharge" to="Metro_Terminal" length="105.0km" diameter="30inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="95.0bar" />
  </Pipes>
  <Compressors>
    <Compressor name="Compressor_Station_1" from="CS1_Suction" to="CS1_Discharge" type="CENTRIFUGAL" power="18000000" maxRatio="1.75" efficiency="0.83" mode="DISCHARGE_PRESSURE" setpoint="82.0bar" status="RUNNING" />
  </Compressors>
  <GasComposition ch4="0.92" c2h6="0.045" c3h8="0.015" co2="0.010" n2="0.010" h2="0.00" ghv="39.1" />
  <SimulationControls startTime="0" endTime="21600" timeStep="60" eos="AGA8" steadyStateFirst="true" />
</PipelineStudio>

title: Branched Transmission Pipeline with Regulator Valve
description: High-pressure main gas transmission line splitting into an industrial power-plant lateral and a pressure-regulated municipal distribution branch with preheater protection.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<PipelineStudio id="branched_regulator" title="Branched Transmission Pipeline with Regulator Valve" simulationType="TGNET">
  <Nodes>
    <Node name="Interstate_Receipt" type="SUPPLY" elevation="25m" pressure="76.0bar" flow="140.0" />
    <Node name="Tee_Junction" type="JUNCTION" elevation="30m" />
    <Node name="Reg_Inlet" type="JUNCTION" elevation="28m" />
    <Node name="Reg_Outlet" type="JUNCTION" elevation="28m" />
    <Node name="Power_Plant_Gate" type="DELIVERY" elevation="22m" minDeliveryPressure="42.0bar" flow="85.0" />
    <Node name="City_Distribution" type="DELIVERY" elevation="18m" minDeliveryPressure="28.0bar" flow="55.0" />
  </Nodes>
  <Pipes>
    <Pipe name="Main_Feeder" from="Interstate_Receipt" to="Tee_Junction" length="55.0km" diameter="30inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="95.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Power_Lateral" from="Tee_Junction" to="Power_Plant_Gate" length="40.0km" diameter="24inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="90.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Reg_Approach" from="Tee_Junction" to="Reg_Inlet" length="22.0km" diameter="20inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="90.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="City_Feeder" from="Reg_Outlet" to="City_Distribution" length="18.0km" diameter="16inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="60.0bar" />
  </Pipes>
  <Regulators>
    <Regulator name="City_Gate_PRV" from="Reg_Inlet" to="Reg_Outlet" setpoint="42.0bar" capacity="90.0" preheater="true" />
  </Regulators>
  <GasComposition ch4="0.915" c2h6="0.048" c3h8="0.014" co2="0.011" n2="0.012" h2="0.02" ghv="38.8" />
  <SimulationControls startTime="0" endTime="43200" timeStep="60" eos="AGA8" steadyStateFirst="true" />
</PipelineStudio>

title: Linepack Transient Diurnal Demand Swing
description: 24-hour transient linepack management study across a 220 km gas transmission corridor with looped parallel sections, centrifugal compression, and underground storage buffer.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<PipelineStudio id="linepack_swing" title="Linepack Transient Diurnal Demand Swing" simulationType="TGNET">
  <Nodes>
    <Node name="Basin_Supply" type="SUPPLY" elevation="45m" pressure="78.0bar" flow="165.0" />
    <Node name="Loop_Split" type="JUNCTION" elevation="52m" />
    <Node name="Loop_Merge" type="JUNCTION" elevation="48m" />
    <Node name="Mid_CS_Suction" type="JUNCTION" elevation="48m" />
    <Node name="Mid_CS_Discharge" type="JUNCTION" elevation="48m" />
    <Node name="Peak_Market_Hub" type="DELIVERY" elevation="20m" minDeliveryPressure="42.0bar" flow="165.0" />
  </Nodes>
  <Pipes>
    <Pipe name="Inlet_Header" from="Basin_Supply" to="Loop_Split" length="45.0km" diameter="36inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="100.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Loop_North" from="Loop_Split" to="Loop_Merge" length="75.0km" diameter="30inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="100.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Loop_South" from="Loop_Split" to="Loop_Merge" length="75.0km" diameter="24inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="100.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Station_Tie" from="Loop_Merge" to="Mid_CS_Suction" length="5.0km" diameter="36inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="100.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Delivery_Main" from="Mid_CS_Discharge" to="Peak_Market_Hub" length="95.0km" diameter="36inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="100.0bar" />
  </Pipes>
  <Compressors>
    <Compressor name="Midpoint_Booster" from="Mid_CS_Suction" to="Mid_CS_Discharge" type="CENTRIFUGAL" power="24000000" maxRatio="1.7" efficiency="0.85" mode="DISCHARGE_PRESSURE" setpoint="86.0bar" status="RUNNING" />
  </Compressors>
  <GasComposition ch4="0.92" c2h6="0.042" c3h8="0.014" co2="0.010" n2="0.014" h2="0.03" ghv="38.7" />
  <SimulationControls startTime="0" endTime="86400" timeStep="120" eos="AGA8" steadyStateFirst="true" />
</PipelineStudio>

title: Multi-Station Gas Transmission Network with Hourly Demand Profile
description: 350 km interstate natural gas transmission network featuring two series compressor stations, dual market delivery branches with preheated regulation, and a 24-hour demand profile CSV.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<PipelineStudio id="interstate_trunkline" title="Multi-Station Gas Transmission Network" simulationType="TGNET">
  <Nodes>
    <Node name="Permian_Supply" type="SUPPLY" elevation="60m" pressure="76.0bar" flow="210.0" />
    <Node name="CS_West_Suc" type="JUNCTION" elevation="75m" />
    <Node name="CS_West_Dis" type="JUNCTION" elevation="75m" />
    <Node name="Central_Split" type="JUNCTION" elevation="55m" />
    <Node name="CS_East_Suc" type="JUNCTION" elevation="45m" />
    <Node name="CS_East_Dis" type="JUNCTION" elevation="45m" />
    <Node name="Reg_South_In" type="JUNCTION" elevation="40m" />
    <Node name="Reg_South_Out" type="JUNCTION" elevation="40m" />
    <Node name="Coastal_LNG_Hub" type="DELIVERY" elevation="8m" minDeliveryPressure="45.0bar" flow="135.0" />
    <Node name="Southern_City_Gate" type="DELIVERY" elevation="15m" minDeliveryPressure="30.0bar" flow="75.0" />
  </Nodes>
  <Pipes>
    <Pipe name="Seg_West_1" from="Permian_Supply" to="CS_West_Suc" length="95.0km" diameter="36inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="100.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Seg_Central_2" from="CS_West_Dis" to="Central_Split" length="85.0km" diameter="36inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="100.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Seg_East_3" from="Central_Split" to="CS_East_Suc" length="60.0km" diameter="30inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="95.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Seg_Coastal_4" from="CS_East_Dis" to="Coastal_LNG_Hub" length="75.0km" diameter="30inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="95.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Seg_South_Lateral" from="Central_Split" to="Reg_South_In" length="35.0km" diameter="24inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="90.0bar" />
    <Pipe name="Seg_South_Dist" from="Reg_South_Out" to="Southern_City_Gate" length="20.0km" diameter="20inch" roughness="0.000045m" maop="65.0bar" />
  </Pipes>
  <Compressors>
    <Compressor name="CS_West" from="CS_West_Suc" to="CS_West_Dis" type="CENTRIFUGAL" power="26000000" maxRatio="1.75" efficiency="0.84" mode="DISCHARGE_PRESSURE" setpoint="88.0bar" status="RUNNING" />
    <Compressor name="CS_East" from="CS_East_Suc" to="CS_East_Dis" type="CENTRIFUGAL" power="20000000" maxRatio="1.70" efficiency="0.84" mode="DISCHARGE_PRESSURE" setpoint="84.0bar" status="RUNNING" />
  </Compressors>
  <Regulators>
    <Regulator name="South_Gate_PRV" from="Reg_South_In" to="Reg_South_Out" setpoint="46.0bar" capacity="110.0" preheater="true" />
  </Regulators>
  <GasComposition ch4="0.91" c2h6="0.048" c3h8="0.016" co2="0.012" n2="0.014" h2="0.04" ghv="38.9" />
  <SimulationControls startTime="0" endTime="86400" timeStep="60" eos="AGA8" steadyStateFirst="true" />
</PipelineStudio>
